# These are flagged on AbuseIPDB, so when the AI enriches an attack's source IP the
# live reputation lookup confirms it is malicious. Provided/verified by the workshop
# author. Reputation drifts over time — refresh with ./fetch-threat-intel.sh or re-check
# on https://www.abuseipdb.com before the event.
#

# file is mounted into the range-control container). One IP per line; # lines ignored.
